nodes.label: LGwebOS-menubar
nodes.rationale: Community menu-bar remote for LG webOS, independent of LG.

nodes.label: LG 50UN7310PSC
nodes.rationale: Only model the project has verified, on webOS 5.0.

nodes.label: Unverified models stay unverified
nodes.rationale: Other models and webOS versions are not verified until someone reports the model and exact webOS version.

nodes.label: iOS app
nodes.rationale: Same TV session and pairing as the menu bar, stored in that device Keychain, iOS 17.

nodes.label: TV pairing
nodes.rationale: Encrypted WebSocket on port 3001. Certificate fingerprint and pairing key stay in the Mac Keychain. A changed certificate is refused until Forget pairing.

nodes.label: IPv4-only addressing
nodes.rationale: Hostnames and IPv6 are not supported.

nodes.label: Local screen time
nodes.rationale: Collected only while the app is running, connected, and the Mac is awake. Historical TV usage is not available.

nodes.label: Media casting
nodes.rationale: Only the selected file is served, and only while the app stays open. H.264 MP4, MP3, and JPEG are the safest choices.

nodes.label: AirPlay guidance
nodes.rationale: The app shows macOS Screen Mirroring guidance. It does not start mirroring or capture the TV screen.

nodes.label: No shipped TV identity
nodes.rationale: The repository ships with no TV address, device name, model, MAC address, or pairing key.

nodes.label: Do not guess TV identity
nodes.rationale: Ask for model, IPv4, and MAC. Never invent them.

nodes.label: Pairing lockout caution
nodes.rationale: Do not retry the same pairing request repeatedly, because the TV may lock out repeated attempts.

nodes.label: Keep secrets out of git
nodes.rationale: IP, MAC, serial, and pairing key stay in app settings or .local/, which git ignores.

nodes.label: LGwebOSCore
nodes.rationale: Shared TV session: SSAP, certificate pinning, discovery, pointer input, casting, and local history. No AppKit or UIKit.

nodes.label: LGwebOSUI
nodes.rationale: Shared SwiftUI pieces. The menu bar and iOS app compose them separately.

nodes.label: LGwebOSMenubar
nodes.rationale: Menu bar shell, command-line checks, and Mac settings prompts.

nodes.label: LG registration manifest
nodes.rationale: Public LG test-client manifest from PyWebOSTV, not a user serial or pairing key.

nodes.label: Bundled app icons
nodes.rationale: Third-party branding from the LG app launcher. The project MIT license does not relicense them.

nodes.label: tv-hero illustration
nodes.rationale: AI-generated project illustration. Embedded content provenance metadata is preserved.
